generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A fixed-path delivery certificate inherited unchanged from a base branch can be mistaken for evidence produced by the current delivery target.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Validate only the certificate subject observed at the head without proving whether the fixed-path artifact was inherited unchanged from the exact base revision.

reusable_control.procedure: Compare identity artifacts at the material head against the exact base revision before semantic target reuse decisions.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: A delivery producer must rebuild and publish a target-bound handoff whenever the only existing certificate is inherited from the base.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Classify byte-identical base/head foreign identity artifacts as inherited-base artifacts and require current-target publication.

transfer_cases.evidence: Current generic target-binding regression suite classifies a byte-identical foreign base artifact as inherited history.
Current generic target-binding regression suite keeps a changed foreign head certificate classified as a foreign current artifact.
